source: OWASP AI Security Testing Guide — Database-AI Interaction, RAG Security, Red Team Testing
description: QRadar SIEM alert rules for AI database attacks, RAG pipeline exploitation, vector database abuse, and red team scenarios

rules.name: SQL Injection via LLM-Generated Query (PostgreSQL)
rules.description: Detects SQL injection in queries generated by LLM systems targeting PostgreSQL databases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM%' OR payload ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%OR 1=1--%') AND (payload ILIKE '%pg_%' OR payload ILIKE '%information_schema%' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_catalog%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Injection via LLM-Generated Query (MySQL)
rules.description: Detects SQL injection in queries generated by LLM systems targeting MySQL databases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM%' OR payload ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%OR 1=1--%') AND (payload ILIKE '%mysql.%' OR payload ILIKE '%information_schema%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Injection via LLM-Generated Query (SQL Server)
rules.description: Detects SQL injection in queries generated by LLM systems targeting Microsoft SQL Server
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM%' OR payload ILIKE '%EXEC xp_%' OR payload ILIKE '%OPENROWSET%') AND (payload ILIKE '%sys.%' OR payload ILIKE '%master..%' OR payload ILIKE '%INFORMATION_SCHEMA%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Injection via LLM-Generated Query (Oracle)
rules.description: Detects SQL injection in queries generated by LLM systems targeting Oracle databases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM%' OR payload ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%UTL_HTTP%') AND (payload ILIKE '%ALL_TABLES%' OR payload ILIKE '%ALL_TAB_COLUMNS%' OR payload ILIKE '%dba_%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: NoSQL Injection via LLM-Generated Query (MongoDB)
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection in queries generated by LLM systems targeting MongoDB
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%$where%' OR payload ILIKE '%$regex%' OR payload ILIKE '%$gt:%' OR payload ILIKE '%$ne:%' OR payload ILIKE '%$or:%') AND (payload ILIKE '%mongo%' OR payload ILIKE '%db.%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: NoSQL Injection via LLM-Generated Query (DynamoDB)
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection in queries generated by LLM systems targeting AWS DynamoDB
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%KeyConditionExpression%' OR payload ILIKE '%FilterExpression%') AND (payload ILIKE '%:v1%' OR payload ILIKE '%$or%') AND payload ILIKE '%dynamodb%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Graph Database Injection via LLM (Neo4j Cypher)
rules.description: Detects Cypher injection in queries generated by LLM systems targeting Neo4j graph databases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/graph%') AND (payload ILIKE '%MATCH (n)%' OR payload ILIKE '%CREATE (n)%' OR payload ILIKE '%DETACH DELETE%') AND (payload ILIKE '%WITH %' OR payload ILIKE '%CALL {%' OR payload ILIKE '%LOAD CSV%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_query_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Graph Database Injection via LLM (Gremlin)
rules.description: Detects Gremlin query injection in LLM-generated queries targeting graph databases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/graph%') AND (payload ILIKE '%g.V(%' OR payload ILIKE '%g.E(%' OR payload ILIKE '%.addVertex%' OR payload ILIKE '%.drop()%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_query_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database Query Abuse (Pinecone)
rules.description: Detects unauthorized or abusive queries targeting Pinecone vector database
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%pinecone.io/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8080/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/vectors/query%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database Query Abuse (Weaviate)
rules.description: Detects unauthorized or abusive queries targeting Weaviate vector database via GraphQL
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/v1/objects%' OR URL ILIKE '%/v1/batch%' OR URL ILIKE '%weaviate%') AND (payload ILIKE '%Get{%' OR payload ILIKE '%Aggregate{%' OR payload ILIKE '%Explore{%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database Query Abuse (ChromaDB)
rules.description: Detects unauthorized or abusive queries targeting ChromaDB vector database
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:8000/api/v1/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/collections/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%get%' OR payload ILIKE '%query%' OR payload ILIKE '%peek%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database Query Abuse (Qdrant)
rules.description: Detects unauthorized or abusive queries targeting Qdrant vector database
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:6333/collections/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:6333/points/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database Query Abuse (Milvus)
rules.description: Detects unauthorized or abusive queries targeting Milvus vector database
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:19530/v2/vectordb/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/milvus/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Embedding Extraction from Vector Database
rules.description: Detects bulk embedding data extraction from vector databases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count, SUM(LONG(LENGTH(payload))) as total_bytes FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/embeddings%' OR URL ILIKE '%/vectors/get%' OR URL ILIKE '%/points/scroll%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING query_count > 100 OR total_bytes > 1000000

rules.name: Vector Database Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects authentication bypass attempts on vector database endpoints
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/collections/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/vectors/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/points/%') AND (URL ILIKE '%?api_key=***' OR header_value ILIKE '%Bearer null%' OR header_value ILIKE '%Bearer anonymous%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database Cross-Namespace Access
rules.description: Detects cross-namespace access attempts in vector databases indicating tenant isolation failure
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/collections/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/namespaces/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%namespace=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/namespaces/other_tenant%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database Index Manipulation Attack
rules.description: Detects unauthorized index creation, deletion, or modification on vector databases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/collections/%/index%' OR URL ILIKE '%/collections/create%' OR URL ILIKE '%/collections/delete%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Vector Database DoS via Dimension Flooding
rules.description: Detects denial-of-service attacks on vector databases through excessive vector insertion
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as insert_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/points/upsert%' OR URL ILIKE '%/vectors/upsert%' OR URL ILIKE '%/collections/%/add%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING insert_count > 500

rules.name: Redis Cache Poisoning via AI Pipeline
rules.description: Detects cache poisoning attacks on Redis caches used in AI inference pipelines
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%SET %' OR payload ILIKE '%MSET %') AND (payload ILIKE '%cache%' OR payload ILIKE '%inference_result%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') AND destinationport = 6379 LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Elasticsearch Query Injection via LLM
rules.description: Detects Elasticsearch query injection through LLM-generated search requests
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:9200/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/elasticsearch/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/es/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%script_score%' OR payload ILIKE '%runtime_mappings%' OR payload ILIKE '%_source%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ai_service') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: MongoDB Document Injection via LLM
rules.description: Detects MongoDB document injection attacks through LLM-generated queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%$where%' OR payload ILIKE '%$regex%' OR payload ILIKE '%$expr%' OR payload ILIKE '%$jsonSchema%') AND (payload ILIKE '%mongo%' OR payload ILIKE '%document%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI-Assisted Schema Enumeration (PostgreSQL)
rules.description: Detects LLM-assisted database schema enumeration targeting PostgreSQL system catalogs
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%pg_catalog%' OR payload ILIKE '%information_schema%' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_class%' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_tables%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_admin_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: AI-Assisted Schema Enumeration (MySQL)
rules.description: Detects LLM-assisted database schema enumeration targeting MySQL information_schema
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%information_schema%' OR payload ILIKE '%SHOW TABLES%' OR payload ILIKE '%SHOW DATABASES%' OR payload ILIKE '%DESCRIBE %') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_admin_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: RAG Pipeline Data Theft via Document Enumeration
rules.description: Detects enumeration of RAG document sources to extract knowledge base contents
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/documents%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/knowledge/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/sources%') AND (payload ILIKE '%GET%' OR payload ILIKE '%list%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING query_count > 20

rules.name: RAG Pipeline Data Theft via Vector Similarity Scan
rules.description: Detects systematic vector similarity scanning to extract RAG knowledge base contents
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/search%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/similar%') AND payload ILIKE '%vector%' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING query_count > 50

rules.name: RAG Pipeline Data Theft via Metadata Extraction
rules.description: Detects extraction of RAG document metadata to enumerate knowledge base contents
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/documents/metadata%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/sources/metadata%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_user') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: RAG Data Exposure via Source Enumeration
rules.description: Detects enumeration of RAG data sources revealing internal document structure
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(DISTINCT URL) as source_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/sources%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/documents/%/source%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING source_count > 10

rules.name: RAG Data Exposure via Citation Analysis
rules.description: Detects systematic analysis of AI citations to enumerate RAG source documents
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as citation_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%source:%' OR payload ILIKE '%citation:%' OR payload ILIKE '%reference:%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING citation_count > 30

rules.name: Knowledge Base Extraction via Progressive Query Expansion
rules.description: Detects progressive query expansion attacks on AI knowledge bases
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payload) as unique_queries FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING unique_queries > 100

rules.name: AI-Assisted Data Exfiltration via UNION-Based SQL Injection
rules.description: Detects LLM-assisted data exfiltration using UNION-based SQL injection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%UNION ALL SELECT%') AND (payload ILIKE '%FROM users%' OR payload ILIKE '%FROM customers%' OR payload ILIKE '%FROM payments%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI-Assisted Blind SQL Injection via Timing
rules.description: Detects LLM-assisted blind SQL injection using timing-based techniques
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, LONG(LENGTH(payload)) as response_time FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SLEEP(%' OR payload ILIKE '%WAITFOR DELAY%' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_sleep%' OR payload ILIKE '%benchmark(%') AND LONG(LENGTH(payload)) > 5000 LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI-Assisted Data Exfiltration via MongoDB Enumeration
rules.description: Detects LLM-assisted data exfiltration through MongoDB document enumeration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%find(%' OR payload ILIKE '%aggregate(%' OR payload ILIKE '%$lookup%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING query_count > 20

rules.name: Redis Key Enumeration via LLM
rules.description: Detects LLM-assisted Redis key enumeration and data extraction
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%KEYS *%' OR payload ILIKE '%SCAN %' OR payload ILIKE '%HGETALL %') AND destinationport = 6379 AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Neo4j Path Traversal via Cypher Injection
rules.description: Detects path traversal in Cypher queries through LLM-generated graph database queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/graph%') AND (payload ILIKE '%LOAD CSV FROM%' OR payload ILIKE '%CALL {%' OR payload ILIKE '%apoc.load.json%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_query_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: InfluxDB Flux Query Injection via LLM
rules.description: Detects Flux query injection through LLM-generated time-series database queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:8086/api/v2/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/influxdb/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%from(bucket:%' OR payload ILIKE '%range(%') AND (payload ILIKE '%csv.from(%' OR payload ILIKE '%http.get(%' OR payload ILIKE '%file.read(%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Redis Lua Sandbox Escape via LLM
rules.description: Detects Lua sandbox escape attempts through LLM-generated Redis commands
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%EVAL %' OR payload ILIKE '%EVALSHA %') AND (payload ILIKE '%os.execute%' OR payload ILIKE '%io.popen%' OR payload ILIKE '%require "os"%' OR payload ILIKE '%dofile%') AND destinationport = 6379 LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI-Assisted Database Fingerprinting via LLM
rules.description: Detects LLM-assisted database fingerprinting through error-based or inference-based techniques
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(DISTINCT payload) as unique_errors FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/ask%') AND (payload ILIKE '%version()%' OR payload ILIKE '%@@version%' OR payload ILIKE '%SELECT @@%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING unique_errors > 10

rules.name: Firestore Security Rule Bypass via AI
rules.description: Detects Firestore security rule bypass attempts through AI-generated queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%firestore.googleapis.com/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/firestore/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%allow read, write:%' OR payload ILIKE '%request.auth.uid%' OR payload ILIKE '%resource.data%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_mobile_app') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: AI Pipeline Redis Module Command Injection
rules.description: Detects Redis module command injection through AI pipeline connections
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%MODULE LOAD%' OR payload ILIKE '%CONFIG SET%' OR payload ILIKE '%SLAVEOF%' OR payload ILIKE '%REPLICAOF%') AND destinationport = 6379 AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_redis_admin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: CouchDB View Code Injection via LLM
rules.description: Detects CouchDB view code injection through LLM-generated queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%:5984/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/couchdb/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%_design/%' OR payload ILIKE '%_view/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%function(%' OR payload ILIKE '%emit(%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Red Team - Prompt Injection to Credential Exfiltration Chain
rules.description: Detects multi-stage attack chains from initial prompt injection through to credential exfiltration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%password%' OR payload ILIKE '%api_key%' OR payload ILIKE '%secret%' OR payload ILIKE '%token%') AND (payload ILIKE '%ignore previous instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%system:%') GROUP BY sourceip, username, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Red Team - RAG Poisoning to Cross-Tenant Data Access
rules.description: Detects RAG data poisoning that enables cross-tenant data access in multi-tenant AI systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/documents/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/knowledge/add%') AND (payload ILIKE '%ignore previous%' OR payload ILIKE '%system instruction%' OR payload ILIKE '%IMPORTANT:%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_content_manager') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Red Team - AI Output Injection to SSRF Chain
rules.description: Detects AI model outputs that contain internal URLs enabling SSRF on downstream systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%http://169.254.169.254%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://metadata.google.internal%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://100.100.100.200%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Red Team - AI Tool Authorization Bypass to Database Access
rules.description: Detects AI tool authorization bypass enabling unauthorized database access
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/function%') AND (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM%' OR payload ILIKE '%db.query%' OR payload ILIKE '%execute_sql%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_tool' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Red Team - AI Agent Sandbox Escape to Host System
rules.description: Detects attempts by AI agents to escape sandbox environments and access host system resources
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/agent%') AND (payload ILIKE '%/etc/passwd%' OR payload ILIKE '%/etc/shadow%' OR payload ILIKE '%/proc/self%' OR payload ILIKE '%/var/run/docker.sock%' OR payload ILIKE '%subprocess.call%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Red Team - Training Pipeline Compromise Detection
rules.description: Detects suspicious modifications to AI training pipelines indicating backdoor injection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/train%' OR URL ILIKE '%/pipeline%' OR URL ILIKE '%/job/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%backdoor%' OR payload ILIKE '%trigger%' OR payload ILIKE '%poison%' OR payload ILIKE '%malicious%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Red Team - Multi-Modal Prompt Injection (Image/Voice)
rules.description: Detects multi-modal prompt injection attempts through images, audio, or other media inputs
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/image%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/audio%') AND (payload ILIKE '%ignore instructions%' OR payload ILIKE '%system prompt%' OR payload ILIKE '%hidden text%' OR payload ILIKE '%steganography%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Red Team - AI Agent Privilege Escalation via Tool Access Chain
rules.description: Detects AI agents progressively escalating privileges through chained tool access
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(DISTINCT URL) as tool_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tool/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/function/%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING tool_count > 5

rules.name: Red Team - LLM Output Manipulation to Phishing
rules.description: Detects AI model outputs designed for social engineering or phishing attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%verify your account%' OR payload ILIKE '%click here to reset%' OR payload ILIKE '%urgent security alert%' OR payload ILIKE '%confirm your identity%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Red Team - Embedding Model Theft via API
rules.description: Detects systematic extraction of embedding models through high-volume API queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count, SUM(LONG(LENGTH(payload))) as total_input_bytes FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/embeddings%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/encode%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING query_count > 5000 OR total_input_bytes > 10000000

rules.name: Red Team - Fine-Tuning API Abuse for Model Poisoning
rules.description: Detects unauthorized fine-tuning API access that could lead to model poisoning
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/fine-tune%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/train%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/model/upload%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Red Team - Token Limit Bypass for Context Window Data Mining
rules.description: Detects context window exploitation for progressive data extraction through multi-turn conversations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, SUM(LONG(LENGTH(payload))) as total_bytes, COUNT(*) as turn_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%tell me more%' OR payload ILIKE '%continue%' OR payload ILIKE '%what else%' OR payload ILIKE '%expand on that%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING total_bytes > 500000 OR turn_count > 50

rules.name: Red Team - AI Inference Endpoint Side-Channel Attack
rules.description: Detects side-channel attacks on AI inference endpoints based on timing or output patterns
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as request_count, AVG(response_time) as avg_time FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/predict%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/infer%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING request_count > 2000

rules.name: Red Team - Conversation History Extraction via Prompt Manipulation
rules.description: Detects prompt manipulation designed to extract conversation history of other users
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%previous conversation%' OR payload ILIKE '%chat history%' OR payload ILIKE '%other users%' OR payload ILIKE '%show me what%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_user' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Red Team - Supply Chain Plugin Compromise
rules.description: Detects suspicious AI plugin or tool registrations indicating supply chain compromise
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/plugins%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tools%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_plugin_registry') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Red Team - PII Leakage via Targeted Generation Queries
rules.description: Detects targeted PII extraction queries designed to cause the AI model to reveal personal data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/chat%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/completion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%social security number%' OR payload ILIKE '%credit card number%' OR payload ILIKE '%date of birth%' OR payload ILIKE '%phone number%' OR payload ILIKE '%home address%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Red Team - Embedding Inversion Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects embedding inversion attacks attempting to reconstruct input data from embedding vectors
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/embeddings%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/vectors/query%') AND (payload ILIKE '%reconstruct%' OR payload ILIKE '%inverse%' OR payload ILIKE '%decode%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING query_count > 50

rules.name: Red Team - Training Data Extraction via Gradient Leakage
rules.description: Detects gradient leakage attacks that extract training data through model gradient information
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/gradients%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/train/gradient%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_ml_engineer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Red Team - Differential Privacy Bypass Testing
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass differential privacy protections through statistical queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/query%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/aggregate%') AND (payload ILIKE '%average%' OR payload ILIKE '%count%' OR payload ILIKE '%sum%' OR payload ILIKE '%distribution%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING query_count > 100

rules.name: Red Team - Model Fingerprinting for Training Data Identification
rules.description: Detects model fingerprinting attacks designed to identify specific training data characteristics
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as probe_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/predict%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/classify%') AND (payload ILIKE '%confidence%' OR payload ILIKE '%probability%' OR payload ILIKE '%logit%' OR payload ILIKE '%entropy%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING probe_count > 500
